channel.title: LoomSci - Quantum Physics
channel.description: Latest Quantum Physics articles from LoomSci

item.title: Taming Rydberg Decay: A Smarter Way to Protect Quantum Information
item.description: Rydberg decay errors in neutral atom qubits are located and corrected using the final measurement pattern in a topological cluster state.

item.title: The Quantum Adapter That Learned to Improve Language
item.description: A quantum circuit adapter improves language model performance by inserting two-qubit unitary blocks into frozen transformer layers.

item.title: How a 2D Code Learned Magic
item.description: A two-dimensional stabilizer code reaches beyond its dimensional ceiling, using cup products to weave a transversal T-gate directly into the fabric.

item.title: The Invisible Dimension that Decides Spin Squeezing
item.description: The spectral dimension of a spin network's connectivity decides whether scalable quantum squeezing can emerge.

item.title: When Noise's Memory Becomes Its Undoing
item.description: In an NMR quantum processor, the Petz recovery map turns noise's own memory into a tailored undo operation, achieving high fidelity when the reference state matches the channel's fixed point.
